grasp: toolchains/grasp/build/bin (pinned 9006157730a82ac839f2b4ff4e938bcba63a539e, serial build: no MPI binaries, no mpirun on Sirius)
why: Literature check (Li, Jonsson, Amarsi, Li & Grumer 2023, O I, arXiv 2304.02310): the v44 gauge-split mechanism (lower-level 2p3 np admixture) is placed INTO the multireference there, with SD correlation on top, in GRASP MCDHF-EOL + RCI. FAC central-potential orbitals cannot be variationally contracted correlation orbitals, so the expansion moves to GRASP (the plan's declared primary method); FAC remains the independent cross-check. Li's final RCI (12.6M/7.7M CSFs) exceeds Sirius (4 cores, 15 GB), so a scaled scheme is sized first.
scope: rcsfgenerate ONLY: Li Table 1 MR for {mcdhf (1s,2s closed; SD from 2p+outer), rci (1s closed; SD from n=2+outer, extended MR incl. 2s2p4 ns/nd)} x {even 2J 0-4, odd 2J 2-4} x n_max 6..9 (l<=h). MR orbitals above n_max omitted and recorded. No SCF, energies, rates or grades.
guards: Fresh directory; small-to-large order; 3600 s per case; stop and preserve the first failure/timeout. Streamed native inventory per case (8 electrons, closed 1s, closed 2s for mcdhf, parity, no duplicates, counts per J block), rcsf sha256 and bytes.
evidence: Receipts, stdin/stdout/stderr and inventories archived; CSF lists above the size cap stay on Sirius, regenerable from stdin + pinned executable.
